name: 49-symonds-street
refs_note: the folder of refs/ that holds the reference views (views.json, masks/), which refine, compare, metrics, sky_mask and the viewer's ?sv= read: refs/photos (gitignored), whose views tools/photo_camera.py writes. Its one photograph is taken from Symonds Street to the building's east, about 50 m from its north-east face, looking up 24 degrees through a lens of about 34 degrees across; its camera is fitted to the north-east face's gable and to the tops of the steps of its east corner, and to two upright edges, with the principal point at the centre.

building.title: 49 Symonds Street (620), University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 620's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 620 by its id.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

ground_note: 56.79 m: the median LiDAR ground (class 2) in the first crop, 25 m round the outline (p5 52.42, p95 59.45: the site falls about 7 m across the crop); provisional, to be the LiDAR's ground at the door at step 7

light.note: estimated: the photograph has no date and soft light under broken cloud; the viewer's sun stands on the north-east face's side, 75 deg round and 30 deg up (behind it, the faces it shows go dark: luma p50 77 at 1.0); the exposure from the building's luma: p10/p50/p90 92/134/242 at 0.8 against the photograph's 98/132/224 (125 at 0.7), with round 1's faces
